Ana Rivera: Quick thought: what if the ingress proxy trims high-card attrs but emits a tiny recovery token that enrichment can use for 48h? reduces ingest cost but keeps recon path.
CJ Park: Interesting. Need rules: billing_key must be computed deterministically at ingress. recovery token = sha256(trace_id+ts) stored in short-lived cache.
Michael Li: Two concerns: cache growth and debugging. limit tokens to billing-sensitive routes and TTL 48h + LRU.
Sara Gupta: Sampling interplay: if sampling happens later we must either sample at ingress or ensure token lets us fetch attrs for late samples.
Ana Rivera: Fallback: if cache down, emit full attrs (short-term) or mark trace as degraded and route to safe fallback behavior.
CJ Park: Ops/security: encryption at rest (KMS) and RBAC for enrichment reads. Prefer reusing existing enrichment-cache service.
ingest-bot: Note: created ticket INF-7201 "ingress-trim-token" (assignee: CJ Park). :robot_face:
Ana Rivera: Action items: CJ -> capacity + cost estimate; Michael -> spike on cache integration; Sara -> define recoverability SLI. Target: prototype behind feature-flag next sprint.
